scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Bind each render to an immutable pair of source versions.
families.actor_operation_target: Service records the chosen video and caption revision when a render is requested and uses those exact files.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Fixed inputs prevent later edits or changing defaults from altering the rendered combination.
families.conditions: Preserve private storage, retained delivered versions, and the required final format.
families.assumptions: Sources can be versioned or copied within the storage and engineering allowance.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Show source revisions and request order in preview history.
families.actor_operation_target: Service labels each preview with video revision, caption revision, request time, and completion status.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Editors can identify the intended combination even when jobs finish out of order.
families.conditions: Earlier delivered versions and original caption wording remain accessible.
families.assumptions: Revision labels are understandable and metadata accurately describes each output.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Render on explicit request or after an editing pause.
families.actor_operation_target: Editor requests a preview when ready, or the service waits for a quiet interval before starting a pending render.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Fewer superseded jobs can reduce unnecessary computation and queue waiting.
families.conditions: Respect the existing computing allowance and retain any already delivered version.
families.assumptions: Editors can tolerate delayed automatic rendering and queue demand contributes to waits.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Offer a lightweight caption overlay preview.
families.actor_operation_target: Private browser interface displays the selected captions over the selected video before a full embedded-caption render.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Editors check wording and approximate timing quickly while reserving full rendering for delivery verification.
families.conditions: The present embedded-caption delivery format remains available and private accounts contain the material.
families.assumptions: The overlay can represent timing well enough for preliminary review within the engineering budget.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: How much delay comes from rendering versus finding and reviewing outputs?
families.actor_operation_target: Analyst compares render timestamps with editor observations of choosing, downloading, and watching previews.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Separated durations identify whether compute time or version interpretation dominates the slow sessions.
families.conditions: Use existing private staging and consenting editors.
families.assumptions: Observed sessions reflect the work that misses the time target.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which input-selection events precede an unexpected preview?
families.actor_operation_target: Analyst traces source hashes, request times, completion order, and editor expectations in demonstration sessions.
families.causal_path_or_observable: The trace distinguishes mistaken selection from incorrect binding or misleading history order.
families.conditions: Keep earlier versions intact and use fabricated demonstration footage.
families.assumptions: Available events can be linked to the files actually downloaded.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
